nodes.description: Private owner address set in the constructor to msg.sender; gates privileged functions.
Public mapping of token balances; manually mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of owner-to-spender allowances; mutated in approve and transferFrom.
Private mapping marking addresses allowed to sell; written by _mints and read by ensure.
Private mapping counting how many times an address has sold; incremented in transferFrom.
Private minimum sale amount, set by init and checked by condition.
Private maximum sale amount, set by init and checked by condition.
Private maximum number of sales per address, set by init and checked by condition.
Privileged sell-exempt address set by setTradeAddress and read by ensure.
Public total token supply assigned in the constructor.
Public constant decimals equal to 18, used for scaling amounts.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as sender.
Internal view sell gate that whitelists owner, UNI/pair and canSale addresses, otherwise calls condition.
Public payable transferFrom performing manual allowance and balance arithmetic without SafeMath.
Public payable approval writer that sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale constraints.
Owner-only function performing arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address and data.
Public minting function callable only by owner or four hardcoded addresses; sets balances and canSale.
Owner-only initialization of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale parameters.
Owner-only loop distributing tokens to many recipients with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress sell-exempt address.
Pure function computing a Uniswap pair address via keccak256 of factory, sorted tokens and init code hash.
Payable constructor assigning name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and infinite UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled sender used as sender identity and for owner/privilege checks throughout the contract.
Arbitrary delegatecall executed in delegate() against a user-controlled address and calldata.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath in transferFrom.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath in transferFrom.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ performed without SafeMath in transferFrom.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total performed without SafeMath in batchSend.
total = _value * _tos.length multiplication without SafeMath in batchSend.
addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) multiplication without SafeMath in _mints.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter _to of transfer.
Amount parameter _value of transferFrom.
Source address parameter _from of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter _spender of approve.
Address parameter addr of setTradeAddress.
Mint amount parameter addedValue of _mints.
Recipient parameter spender of _mints.
Recipient array parameter _tos of batchSend.
Per-recipient amount parameter _value of batchSend.
Target address parameter a of delegate used in delegatecall.
Calldata parameter b of delegate used in delegatecall.
Number-of-sales parameter saleNum of init.
Minimum sale parameter token of init.
Maximum sale parameter maxToken of init.
Local _UNI pair address computed by pairFor inside ensure.
Local total amount to distribute computed in batchSend.
Loop index i in batchSend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as _from into transfer.
msg.sender is used for the allowance check and debit in transferFrom.
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping written by approve.
msg.sender must equal owner to reach the arbitrary delegatecall.
msg.sender is checked against owner and hardcoded addresses before minting.
msg.sender must equal owner to initialize sale parameters.
msg.sender must equal owner to execute batchSend.
msg.sender must equal owner to set the trade address.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives initial supply in the constructor.
transfer forwards all logic to transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure to gate the sale.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
transferFrom performs the unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value update.
transferFrom performs the unchecked allowance debit.
transferFrom performs the unchecked _onSaleNum increment.
transferFrom performs the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value update.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
ensure invokes condition for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure reads canSale[_from] for whitelisting.
ensure grants unconditional transfer when _from or _to is owner.
ensure grants unconditional transfer when _from is tradeAddress.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from].
condition reads _saleNum.
condition reads _minSale.
condition reads _maxSale.
owner is compared against msg.sender in delegate.
owner is compared against msg.sender in _mints.
owner is compared against msg.sender in init.
owner is compared against msg.sender in batchSend.
owner is compared against msg.sender in setTradeAddress.
delegate executes the arbitrary delegatecall operation.
The arbitrary delegatecall can re-enter state-changing functions such as transferFrom before balances settle.
_mints writes balanceOf[spender].
_mints sets canSale[spender] to true.
_mints performs the unchecked addedValue scaling multiplication.
init writes _minSale.
init writes _maxSale.
init writes _saleNum.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf entries.
batchSend performs the unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total update.
batchSend performs the unchecked total multiplication.
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor assigns the whole supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor sets an infinite allowance for the UNI router.
constructor sets totalSupply.
